product.title: Mount Vernon and Old Town Alexandria Day Trip

description.text: Day-trip to George Washington's Mount Vernon estate and Old Town Alexandria on a six-hour tour from Washington, D.C. with guided visits to the mansion, museum, and Potomac River grounds followed by time in Alexandria's historic waterfront district. Your guide covers Washington's life at the estate before allowing exploration of King Street shops and cobblestone lanes. Motorcoach transport handles the Virginia drive while Mount Vernon admission is included. This outing suits travelers who want founding-era history paired with a charming colonial town visit.
